title: PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI
summary: Basic vehicle drive (a torque applied directly to the driven wheels) on the vehicle prim or on a separate prim that physxVehicle:drive targets. Outside the drive parse the runtime only checks whether the vehicle prim itself lists it, to take the vehicle prim as the drive when physxVehicle:drive has no target.

interactions.rule: Listing both PhysxVehicleDriveBasicAPI and PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI on a vehicle prim without a physxVehicle:drive target logs an error and the vehicle is not created.
A physxVehicle:drive target is looked up as a standard drive first, then as a basic drive.

notes: The drive parse reads physxVehicleDriveBasic:peakTorque and the runtime applies its live changes; it is not described yet.
